age.evidence: Three hundred thirty-one naive, non-stressed Wistar rats (231 males and 100 females) aged 90 -120 days were used.

sex.evidence: Three hundred thirty-one naive, non-stressed Wistar rats (231 males and 100 females) aged 90 -120 days were used.

dosing.doses_raw: AYA solution containing 0.1, 0.3 or 1.0 mg·kg−1 of DMT
dosing.evidence: AYA was thawed, diluted in distilled water before use and administered orally (per gavage) in a 2.5-ml·kg−1 volume. EPM and Experiment 3 used a single dose given 60 min before testing; Experiments 5–8, 11 and 12 gave AYA '60 min before each one of two extinction learning sessions performed 1 day apart'.

handling.evidence: No handling protocol is described in the Methods.

group_housing.evidence: kept in groups of four in polypropylene cages

day_night_flipped.evidence: on a 12-h light/dark cycle, with lights on at 7:00 AM ... behavioural procedures were performed ... from 1:00 PM to 5:00 PM

assays.assay_description: 5-min test in a wooden elevated plus-maze, with two open arms (50 × 10 cm) and two enclosed arms (50 × 10 × 40 cm) set 50 cm above the floor. The test was run 60 min after oral AYA or vehicle in naive males (Exp 1; three doses), naive females (Exp 2) and fear-conditioned males (Exp 4). Measures were % open-arm time, stretched-attend postures and enclosed-arm entries.

application_type.evidence: administered orally (per gavage) in a 2.5-ml·kg−1 volume

setup_habituation.evidence: No pre-test exposure to the elevated plus-maze is described.

setup_restrain.evidence: The EPM is a free-movement apparatus and no restraint is described: 'A 5-min test in the elevated plus-maze was conducted.'

food_restriction.evidence: No food in the EPM apparatus; animals 'had free access to water and standard laboratory chow' in the home cage.

water_restriction.evidence: No water in the EPM apparatus during the 5-min test.

time_to_assay.evidence: given 60 min before the elevated plus-maze test

sample_size.evidence: Exp 1: n = 13, 11, 11 and 12; Exp 2: n = 7 and 7; Exp 4: n = 9 and 10

outcomes.summary: AYA (DMT 0.1–1.0 mg/kg) did not change % open-arm time or stretched-attend postures in naive males. The highest dose (1.0 mg/kg DMT) increased enclosed-arm entries, i.e. general exploratory activity. AYA at 0.3 mg/kg had no effect on any measure in naive females or in fear-conditioned males.
outcomes.statistics: Exp 1 enclosed-arm entries: η2 = 0.17; AYA (DMT 1.0) vs VEH P ≤ 0.05 (one-way ANOVA followed by Newman–Keuls). Exp 2 (t test) and Exp 4: no significant effects.
outcomes.evidence: During the elevated plus-maze test, oral treatment did not influence % open-arm time or stretched-attend postures... The AYA (DMT 1.0) group presented significantly higher values than the VEH group. Neither the AYA (DMT 0.3) nor the AYA (DMT 0.1) group differed from the controls.

B1_num_measures.evidence: Reported results are % open-arm time, number of stretched-attend postures and number of enclosed-arm entries (Figure 2b–d, f–h; Figure 3f–h).

B2_temporal_dynamics.evidence: Only whole-session totals from the 5-min test are reported.

B3_sequential_structure.evidence: No transition or sequence analysis is reported.

B4_ethological.evidence: The number of stretched-attend postures, where the animal stretches forward and retracts to its original position ... was also recorded.

B5_social.evidence: Anxiety/exploration test with no social component.

B6_cognitive.evidence: The animal's anxiety response level was inferred from avoidance (% open-arm time) and risk assessment (stretched-attend postures) behaviours.

B7_automated_classification.evidence: An investigator blinded to the experimental design scored the number of open- and enclosed-arm entries...

B8_multivariate.evidence: Measures were analysed with separate univariate one-way ANOVAs or t tests.

E1_environment_type.evidence: The elevated plus-maze was made of wood and consisted of two opposite open arms ... and two enclosed arms

E2_shelter.evidence: Definitionally absent: EPM closed arms are not a shelter.

E3_bedding.evidence: Definitionally absent: a wooden maze with no bedding.

E5_enrichment.evidence: No objects are described in the apparatus.

E6_spatial.evidence: Per the rubric, EPM arms are not distinct compartments.

E7_social_context.evidence: Animals were tested individually; no conspecific was present.

E8_food_water.evidence: No food or water in the apparatus during the 5-min test.

D1_continuity.evidence: A 5-min test in the elevated plus-maze was conducted.

D3_recording_days.evidence: given 60 min before the elevated plus-maze test (single test day per animal)

assays.assay_description:
Procedure sequence:
- Familiarization in Context A (3 min).
- Conditioning (3 shocks of 1.0 mA, 3 s each).
- One or two 15-min extinction sessions in Context A, 60 min after oral AYA or vehicle; some groups also received intra-IL MDL-11,939 or WAY-100635 10 min before.
- Test A (3 min) for extinction recall.
- Test B (3 min, novel context) for generalization.
- Reinstatement (single shock in Context C).
- Retest A (3 min).
Freezing (% session time) was scored manually from video. This covers Experiments 3 and 5–12 across 1- and 21-day-old memories in both sexes.

application_type.evidence: The psychedelic (AYA) was 'administered orally (per gavage)'. The non-psychedelic antagonists MDL-11,939 and WAY-100635 were infused into the infralimbic cortex in some groups.

setup_habituation.evidence: For familiarization, each animal was placed alone in a rectangular chamber ... designated Context A, allowed to explore it for 3 min and then returned to their respective cage.

setup_restrain.evidence: Animals were placed alone in the chamber and free to move; freezing was scored as absence of movement. Restraint was used only during infusion ('the animal was restrained gently with a towel').

food_restriction.evidence: No food in the conditioning chamber; home-cage chow was available ad libitum.

water_restriction.evidence: No water in the conditioning chamber; home-cage water was available ad libitum.

time_to_assay.evidence: Extinction sessions began 60 min after AYA ('given 60 min before the extinction learning session'). Test A, Test B, reinstatement and Retest A 'were performed in the following days' (≥24 h after the last dose).

outcomes.summary: A single AYA dose (0.3 mg/kg DMT) further reduced freezing within the extinction session but did not affect extinction recall. Two doses on consecutive days reduced freezing during extinction and at Test A (enhanced recall) for 1- and 21-day-old memories in both sexes; reinstatement abolished group differences. Intra-IL MDL-11,939 blocked the within-session AYA effects, and WAY-100635 blocked the between-session (recall) AYA effects.
outcomes.statistics:
Effect sizes by experiment:
- Exp 3: time bin ηp2 = 0.58, oral treatment ηp2 = 0.33; Test A/Test B/Retest A repeated testing ηp2 = 0.86; early extinction vs Test A oral treatment ηp2 = 0.21.
- Exp 5: Ext1 treatment ηp2 = 0.44; Ext2 interaction ηp2 = 0.43; tests interaction ηp2 = 0.29.
- Exp 6: interactions ηp2 = 0.24, 0.53, 0.22.
- Exp 7: interactions ηp2 = 0.33, 0.38, 0.40.
- Exp 8: interactions ηp2 = 0.24, 0.40, 0.23.
- Exp 11: oral × IL treatment ηp2 = 0.48; triple interactions ηp2 = 0.19, 0.26.
- Exp 12: triple interactions ηp2 = 0.09, 0.47.
All analyses used mixed ANOVA with Newman–Keuls, P ≤ 0.05.
outcomes.evidence: These results suggest that repeated oral AYA administration containing 0.3 mg·kg−1 of DMT enhanced fear suppression within extinction learning and during the extinction recall.

B1_num_measures.evidence: Freezing behaviour ... was scored from DVDs ... and expressed as the percentage of total session time.

B2_temporal_dynamics.evidence: Freezing was analysed across five extinction-session blocks: 'time bin (ηp2 = 0.58) and oral treatment (ηp2 = 0.33) significantly influenced the time spent in freezing'.

B3_sequential_structure.evidence: No transition or sequence analysis is reported.

B4_ethological.evidence: Conditioned freezing is excluded per the rubric.

B5_social.evidence: each animal was placed alone in a rectangular chamber

B6_cognitive.evidence: The assay comprises contextual fear conditioning, extinction learning and extinction recall.

B7_automated_classification.evidence: scored from DVDs recorded during the experimental sessions by an investigator blinded to the experimental design

B8_multivariate.evidence: Univariate mixed ANOVAs on freezing only.

E1_environment_type.evidence: rectangular chamber (35 × 20 × 30 cm) with aluminium sidewalls, a front wall and a ceiling door made of Plexiglas

E3_bedding.evidence: Its grid floor, made of stainless steel bars

E4_nesting.evidence: No nesting material in the conditioning chamber.

E5_enrichment.evidence: No enrichment objects in the chamber.

E6_spatial.evidence: Each context is a single rectangular or square chamber. Contexts A, B and C are separate apparatuses, not compartments within one apparatus.

E7_social_context.evidence: each animal was placed alone in a rectangular chamber

E8_food_water.evidence: No food or water in the conditioning chamber.

D1_continuity.evidence: Freezing times expressed at the extinction learning session(s), Test A, Test B, memory reinstatement session and Retest A ... were subjected to mixed ANOVA

D2_session_duration.evidence: Each animal was exposed to the conditioned context in the fear extinction learning session without US presentation for 15 min.

D3_recording_days.evidence: Recording days were 1–2 extinction sessions plus Test A, Test B, reinstatement and Retest A 'performed in the following days' — at most about 7 days.

D4_baseline.evidence: Familiarization and conditioning freezing data were not reported as a pre-drug baseline.

D5_followup.evidence: Test A, Test B, memory reinstatement session and Retest A were performed in the following days.

judge_notes: Kept two assays (EPM and contextual fear conditioning/extinction). All three candidates agreed. Experiments 3 and 5–12 collapse into one fear extinction assay per the rubric (doses, antagonists, memory age, sex and phases are not separate assays).
EPM B1 set to score 1 (2-3 measures): the paper reports three outcome measures. Two candidates gave score 2, but gemma's value label was inconsistent with its score.
EPM B4 = Yes (modal, 2/3): stretched-attend posture is a natural risk-assessment act scored directly.

Fear extinction B1 set to score 0 (1 measure): freezing % is the only behavioural variable. Within- and between-session comparisons are derived from the same measure. This overrides deepseek and gemma.
Fear extinction E6 = 0, rejecting gemma's score of 1: Contexts A, B and C are separate apparatuses, not compartments within one apparatus.
Fear extinction D3 = 2-7 days, rejecting gemma's 8-14: at most about 7 recording days.

Fear extinction application_type set to p.o. rather than 'multiple' (2/3 candidates): C1 concerns the psychedelic's route, and AYA was only given orally. The IL infusions were non-psychedelic antagonists.
Fear extinction time_to_assay set to 'multiple': the assay was recorded both 60 min post-dose (extinction) and ≥24 h post-dose (Test A/B, Retest A).
Dosing schedule set to 'repeated' because most fear experiments used two consecutive daily doses. The EPM and Experiment 3 used single acute doses.

Sample sizes recomputed from the experiment n's: EPM 80 (66 M, 14 F); fear extinction 251 (165 M, 86 F). Both sum to the reported 331 (231 M, 100 F). Experiments 9 and 10 (antagonist only, no AYA) are included in the fear assay count because they share the paradigm.
DOI not present in the markdown and all candidates gave null; kept null.
